item.title: Pick up a print order
item.summary: A print shop calls about an order and offers two collection options.
item.transcript_text: Hi, this is Amina from Maple Print. Your posters are ready, but our front entrance is closed today. If you come before half past five, use the side door on Lake Street. After that we're closed. Tomorrow you can use the front door, but we don't open until ten. You paid online, so you don't need to bring money. Please have the order email ready on your phone and tell us the last name on it.

questions.prompt: How can the customer collect the posters at five today?
options: Use the side door on Lake Street
Come back after half past five
Meet Amina at the bus stop
questions.explanation: The side door is used today before half past five.

questions.prompt: What is true about collecting the posters tomorrow?
options: The side door is the only entrance
The customer must come before ten
The shop will be closed all day
questions.explanation: The front door reopens, but the shop starts at ten.
The message asks the customer to have the order email ready.

children.segment_text: use the side door on Lake Street
have the order email ready on your phone
